name: existence
source:
a short visual novel with point and click elements about being stuck in limbo

rediscover your identity through glimpses of your past 

as you try to remember

the family you have forgotten

[From [url=https://pixelpoxet.itch.io/existence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的视觉小说，其中包含关于陷入困境的点击元素

通过回顾你的过去重新发现你的身份 

当你试图记住时

你已经忘记的家人

[来自[url=https://pixelpoxet.itch.io/existence]itch.io[/url]]
